items.source:
Visits the current state of the local variables and operand stack elements. This method must(*) be called just before any instruction i that follows an unconditional branch instruction such as GOTO or THROW, that is the target of a jump instruction, or that starts an exception handler block. The visited types must describe the values of the local variables and of the operand stack elements just before i is executed.

(*) this is mandatory only for classes whose version is greater than or equal to Opcodes.V1_6.

The frames of a method must be given either in expanded form, or in compressed form (all frames must use the same format, i.e. you must not mix expanded and compressed frames within a single method):
  • In expanded form, all frames must have the F_NEW type.
  • In compressed form, frames are basically "deltas" from the state of the previous frame:
    • Opcodes.F_SAME representing frame with exactly the same locals as the previous frame and with the empty stack.
    • Opcodes.F_SAME1 representing frame with exactly the same locals as the previous frame and with single value on the stack ( numStack is 1 and stack[0] contains value for the type of the stack item).
    • Opcodes.F_APPEND representing frame with current locals are the same as the locals in the previous frame, except that additional locals are defined ( numLocal is 1, 2 or 3 and local elements contains values representing added types).
    • Opcodes.F_CHOP representing frame with current locals are the same as the locals in the previous frame, except that the last 1-3 locals are absent and with the empty stack (numLocal is 1, 2 or 3).
    • Opcodes.F_FULL representing complete frame data.

In both cases the first frame, corresponding to the method's parameters and access flags, is implicit and must not be visited. Also, it is illegal to visit two or more frames for the same code location (i.e., at least one instruction must be visited between two calls to visitFrame).
items.translation:
访问局部变量和运算栈元素的当前状态。此方法必须(*)在无条件分支指令（如 GOTO 或 THROW）之后的任何指令i之前调用，该指令是跳转指令的目标，或是异常处理程序块的起始点。访问的类型必须描述在i执行之前的局部变量和运算栈元素的状态。

(*) 仅对于版本大于或等于 Opcodes.V1_6 的类是强制性的。

方法的帧必须以扩展形式或压缩形式给出（所有帧必须使用相同的格式，即不能在单个方法中混合使用扩展和压缩帧）：
  • 在扩展形式中，所有帧都必须具有 F_NEW 类型。
  • 在压缩形式中，帧基本上是从前一个帧状态的“增量”：
    • Opcodes.F_SAME 表示与前一个帧具有完全相同的局部变量且栈为空的帧。
    • Opcodes.F_SAME1 表示与前一个帧具有完全相同的局部变量且栈上只有一个值的帧（numStack 为 1，stack[0] 包含栈项类型的值）。
    • Opcodes.F_APPEND 表示当前局部变量与前一个帧中的局部变量相同，除了定义了额外的局部变量（numLocal 为 1、2 或 3，local 元素包含表示添加类型的值）。
    • Opcodes.F_CHOP 表示当前局部变量与前一个帧中的局部变量相同，除了最后 1-3 个局部变量不存在且栈为空（numLocal 为 1、2 或 3）。
    • Opcodes.F_FULL 表示完整的帧数据。

在这两种情况下，第一个帧（对应于方法的参数和访问标志）是隐式的，不得对其进行访问。此外，为同一代码位置访问两个或更多帧是非法的（即，在两次调用 visitFrame 之间必须至少访问一条指令）。

items.source:
operand - the operand of the instruction to be visited.
When opcode is BIPUSH, operand value should be between Byte.MIN_VALUE and Byte.MAX_VALUE.
When opcode is SIPUSH, operand value should be between Short.MIN_VALUE and Short.MAX_VALUE.
When opcode is NEWARRAY, operand value should be one of Opcodes.T_BOOLEAN, Opcodes.T_CHAR, Opcodes.T_FLOAT, Opcodes.T_DOUBLE, Opcodes.T_BYTE, Opcodes.T_SHORT, Opcodes.T_INT or Opcodes.T_LONG.
items.translation:
operand - 要访问的指令的操作数。
当 opcode 为 BIPUSH 时，操作数值应在 Byte.MIN_VALUE 和 Byte.MAX_VALUE 之间。
当 opcode 为 SIPUSH 时，操作数值应在 Short.MIN_VALUE 和 Short.MAX_VALUE 之间。
当 opcode 为 NEWARRAY 时，操作数值应为 Opcodes.T_BOOLEAN、Opcodes.T_CHAR、Opcodes.T_FLOAT、Opcodes.T_DOUBLE、Opcodes.T_BYTE、 Opcodes.T_SHORT、Opcodes.T_INT 或 Opcodes.T_LONG 之一。

items.source: cst - the constant to be loaded on the stack. This parameter must be a non null Integer, a Float, a Long, a Double, a String, a Type of OBJECT or ARRAY sort for .class constants, for classes whose version is 49, a Type of METHOD sort for MethodType, a Handle for MethodHandle constants, for classes whose version is 51 or a ConstantDynamic for a constant dynamic for classes whose version is 55.
items.translation: cst - 要压入栈的常量。此参数必须是非空的 Integer、Float、Long、Double、String，或用于 .class 常量的 OBJECT 或 ARRAY 排序的 Type（适用于版本为 49 的类），METHOD 排序的 Type（用于 MethodType），Handle（用于 MethodHandle 常量，适用于版本为 51 的类），或 ConstantDynamic（用于版本为 55 的类的常量动态）。

items.source: local - the local variable types in this frame. This array must not be modified. Primitive types are represented by Opcodes.TOP, Opcodes.INTEGER, Opcodes.FLOAT, Opcodes.LONG, Opcodes.DOUBLE, Opcodes.NULL or Opcodes.UNINITIALIZED_THIS (long and double are represented by a single element). Reference types are represented by String objects (representing internal names, see Type.getInternalName()), and uninitialized types by Label objects (this label designates the NEW instruction that created this uninitialized value).
items.translation: local - 此帧中的局部变量类型。此数组不得修改。基本类型由 Opcodes.TOP、Opcodes.INTEGER、Opcodes.FLOAT、Opcodes.LONG、Opcodes.DOUBLE、Opcodes.NULL 或 Opcodes.UNINITIALIZED_THIS 表示（long 和 double 由单个元素表示）。引用类型由 String 对象表示（表示内部名称，见 Type.getInternalName()），未初始化类型由 Label 对象表示（此标签指定创建该未初始化值的 NEW 指令）。

items.source: bsmArgs - the bootstrap method constant arguments. Each argument must be an Integer, Float, Long, Double, String, Type, Handle or ConstantDynamic value. This method is allowed to modify the content of the array so a caller should expect that this array may change.
items.translation: bsmArgs - 引导方法常量参数。每个参数必须是一个 Integer、Float、Long、Double、String、Type、Handle 或 ConstantDynamic 值。此方法允许修改数组的内容，因此调用者应预期该数组可能会发生变化。

items.source: type - the type of this stack map frame. Must be Opcodes.F_NEW for expanded frames, or Opcodes.F_FULL, Opcodes.F_APPEND, Opcodes.F_CHOP, Opcodes.F_SAME or Opcodes.F_APPEND, Opcodes.F_SAME1 for compressed frames.
items.translation: type - 此堆栈映射帧的类型。对于扩展帧，必须为Opcodes.F_NEW；对于压缩帧，则为Opcodes.F_FULL、Opcodes.F_APPEND、Opcodes.F_CHOP、Opcodes.F_SAME或Opcodes.F_APPEND、Opcodes.F_SAME1。

items.translation: 访问局部变量指令。局部变量指令是指加载或存储局部变量值的指令。

items.source:
Visits a field instruction. A field instruction is an instruction that loads or stores the
value of a field of an object.
items.translation: 访问字段指令。字段指令是指加载或存储对象字段值的指令。

items.source:
Visits a jump instruction. A jump instruction is an instruction that may jump to another
instruction.
items.translation: 访问跳转指令。跳转指令是指可能跳转到另一条指令的指令。

items.source: Visits a label. A label designates the instruction that will be visited just after it.
items.translation: 访问标签。标签指定紧随其后的将被访问的指令。

items.source:
Visits the end of the method. This method, which is the last one to be called, is used to
inform the visitor that all the annotations and attributes of the method have been visited.
items.translation: 访问方法的末尾。此方法是最后被调用的方法，用于通知访客该方法的注解和属性均已访问完毕。

items.source: visitVarInsn in class MethodVisitor
items.translation: `visitVarInsn` 类中的 `MethodVisitor`

items.source: visitIincInsn in class MethodVisitor
items.translation: `visitIincInsn` 类中的 `MethodVisitor`

items.source: visitLocalVariable in class MethodVisitor
items.translation: `visitLocalVariable` 类中的 `MethodVisitor`

items.source: visitMaxs in class MethodVisitor
items.translation: `visitMaxs` 在类 `MethodVisitor` 中

items.source: desc - the field's descriptor (see Type).
items.translation: desc - 字段的描述符（参见Type）。

items.source: labels - beginnings of the handler blocks. labels[i] is the beginning of the handler block for the min + i key.
items.translation: `labels` - 处理程序块的起始位置。labels[i] 是 `min + i` 键对应的处理程序块的起始位置。

items.source: labels - beginnings of the handler blocks. labels[i] is the beginning of the handler block for the keys[i] key.
items.translation: `labels` - 处理程序块的开头。`labels[i]` 是 `keys[i]` 键对应的处理程序块的开头。

items.source: stack - the operand stack types in this frame. This array must not be modified. Its content has the same format as the "local" array.
items.translation: stack - 此帧中的操作数栈类型。此数组不得被修改。其内容与"local"数组的格式相同。

items.source: attr - an attribute.
items.translation: attr - 一个属性。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the instruction to be visited. This opcode is either NOP, ACONST_NULL, ICONST_M1, ICONST_0, ICONST_1, ICONST_2, ICONST_3, ICONST_4, ICONST_5, LCONST_0, LCONST_1, FCONST_0, FCONST_1, FCONST_2, DCONST_0, DCONST_1, IALOAD, LALOAD, FALOAD, DALOAD, AALOAD, BALOAD, CALOAD, SALOAD, IASTORE, LASTORE, FASTORE, DASTORE, AASTORE, BASTORE, CASTORE, SASTORE, POP, POP2, DUP, DUP_X1, DUP_X2, DUP2, DUP2_X1, DUP2_X2, SWAP, IADD, LADD, FADD, DADD, ISUB, LSUB, FSUB, DSUB, IMUL, LMUL, FMUL, DMUL, IDIV, LDIV, FDIV, DDIV, IREM, LREM, FREM, DREM, INEG, LNEG, FNEG, DNEG, ISHL, LSHL, ISHR, LSHR, IUSHR, LUSHR, IAND, LAND, IOR, LOR, IXOR, LXOR, I2L, I2F, I2D, L2I, L2F, L2D, F2I, F2L, F2D, D2I, D2L, D2F, I2B, I2C, I2S, LCMP, FCMPL, FCMPG, DCMPL, DCMPG, IRETURN, LRETURN, FRETURN, DRETURN, ARETURN, RETURN, ARRAYLENGTH, ATHROW, MONITORENTER, or MONITOREXIT.
items.translation: opcode - 要访问的指令的操作码。此操作码可以是 NOP、ACONST_NULL、ICONST_M1、ICONST_0、ICONST_1、ICONST_2、ICONST_3、ICONST_4、ICONST_5、LCONST_0、LCONST_1、FCONST_0、FCONST_1、FCONST_2、DCONST_0、DCONST_1、IALOAD、LALOAD、FALOAD、DALOAD、AALOAD、BALOAD、CALOAD、SALOAD、IASTORE、LASTORE、FASTORE、DASTORE、AASTORE、BASTORE、CASTORE、SASTORE、POP、POP2、DUP、DUP_X1、DUP_X2、DUP2、DUP2_X1、DUP2_X2、SWAP、IADD、LADD、FADD、DADD、ISUB、LSUB、FSUB、DSUB、IMUL、LMUL、FMUL、DMUL、IDIV、LDIV、FDIV、DDIV、IREM、LREM、FREM、DREM、INEG、LNEG、FNEG、DNEG、ISHL、LSHL、ISHR、LSHR、IUSHR、LUSHR、IAND、LAND、IOR、LOR、IXOR、LXOR、I2L、I2F、I2D、L2I、L2F、L2D、F2I、F2L、F2D、D2I、D2L、D2F、I2B、I2C、I2S、LCMP、FCMPL、FCMPG、DCMPL、DCMPG、IRETURN、LRETURN、FRETURN、DRETURN、ARETURN、RETURN、ARRAYLENGTH、ATHROW、MONITORENTER 或 MONITOREXIT。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the instruction to be visited. This opcode is either BIPUSH, SIPUSH or NEWARRAY.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问指令的操作码。此操作码为 BIPUSH、SIPUSH 或 NEWARRAY 之一。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the local variable instruction to be visited. This opcode is either ILOAD, LLOAD, FLOAD, DLOAD, ALOAD, ISTORE, LSTORE, FSTORE, DSTORE, ASTORE or RET.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问的局部变量指令的操作码。此操作码为 ILOAD、LLOAD、FLOAD、DLOAD、ALOAD、ISTORE、LSTORE、FSTORE、DSTORE、ASTORE 或 RET 之一。

items.source: var - the operand of the instruction to be visited. This operand is the index of a local variable.
items.translation: var - 要访问的指令的操作数。此操作数是局部变量的索引。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either NEW, ANEWARRAY, CHECKCAST or INSTANCEOF.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问的类型指令的 opcode。该 opcode 为 NEW、ANEWARRAY、CHECKCAST 或 INSTANCEOF 之一。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either GETSTATIC, PUTSTATIC, GETFIELD or PUTFIELD.
items.translation: opcode - 要访问的类型指令的操作码。此操作码为 GETSTATIC、PUTSTATIC、GETFIELD 或 PUTFIELD 之一。

items.source: name - the field's name.
items.translation: name - 字段的名称。

items.source: opcode - the opcode of the type instruction to be visited. This opcode is either IFEQ, IFNE, IFLT, IFGE, IFGT, IFLE, IF_ICMPEQ, IF_ICMPNE, IF_ICMPLT, IF_ICMPGE, IF_ICMPGT, IF_ICMPLE, IF_ACMPEQ, IF_ACMPNE, GOTO, JSR, IFNULL or IFNONNULL.
items.translation: opcode - 待访问的类型指令的操作码。此操作码为 IFEQ、IFNE、IFLT、IFGE、IFGT、IFLE、IF_ICMPEQ、IF_ICMPNE、IF_ICMPLT、IF_ICMPGE、IF_ICMPGT、IF_ICMPLE、IF_ACMPEQ、IF_ACMPNE、GOTO、JSR、IFNULL 或 IFNONNULL 之一。

items.source: label - the operand of the instruction to be visited. This operand is a label that designates the instruction to which the jump instruction may jump.
items.translation: label - 要访问的指令的操作数。此操作数是指定跳转指令可能跳转到的指令的标签。

items.source: var - index of the local variable to be incremented.
items.translation: var - 要递增的局部变量的索引。

items.source: increment - amount to increment the local variable by.
items.translation: increment - 用于增加局部变量的增量。

items.source: min - the minimum key value.
items.translation: min - 最小键值。

items.source: max - the maximum key value.
items.translation: max - 最大键值。

items.source: keys - the values of the keys. Keys must be sorted in increasing order.
items.translation: keys - 键的值。键必须按升序排序。

items.source: start - the beginning of the exception handler's scope (inclusive).
items.translation: start - 异常处理程序作用域的起始点（包含在内）。

items.source: end - the end of the exception handler's scope (exclusive).
items.translation: end - 异常处理程序作用域的结束（不包含）。

items.source: handler - the beginning of the exception handler's code.
items.translation: handler - 异常处理代码的开头。

items.source: name - the name of a local variable.
items.translation: name - 局部变量的名称。

items.source: desc - the type descriptor of this local variable.
items.translation: desc - 此局部变量的类型描述符。

items.source: signature - the type signature of this local variable. May be null if the local variable type does not use generic types.
items.translation: signature - 此局部变量的类型签名。如果局部变量类型不使用泛型，则可能为 null。

items.source: start - the first instruction corresponding to the scope of this local variable (inclusive).
items.translation: start - 对应此局部变量作用域（包含）的第一条指令。

items.source: end - the last instruction corresponding to the scope of this local variable (exclusive).
items.translation: end - 对应于该局部变量作用域的最后一条指令（不包含）。

items.source: index - the local variable's index.
items.translation: index - 局部变量的索引。

items.source: line - a line number. This number refers to the source file from which the class was compiled.
items.translation: line - 行号。该数字指代编译该类时使用的源文件。

items.source: start - the first instruction corresponding to this line number.
items.translation: start - 对应此行号的第一个指令。

items.source: maxStack - maximum stack size of the method.
items.translation: maxStack - 方法的最大堆栈大小。

items.source: maxLocals - maximum number of local variables for the method.
items.translation: maxLocals - 方法的最大局部变量数。

items.source: name - parameter name or null if none is provided.
items.translation: name - 参数名称，如果未提供则为 null。

items.source: start - the fist instructions corresponding to the continuous ranges that make the scope of this local variable (inclusive).
items.translation: start - 对应于构成此局部变量作用域（包含在内）的连续范围的首条指令。

items.source: end - the last instructions corresponding to the continuous ranges that make the scope of this local variable (exclusive). This array must have the same size as the 'start' array.
items.translation: `end` - 对应于构成此局部变量作用域（不包含）的连续范围的最后指令。此数组的大小必须与 `start` 数组相同。

items.source: index - the local variable's index in each range. This array must have the same size as the 'start' array.
items.translation: index - 每个范围内局部变量的索引。此数组的大小必须与 'start' 数组相同。

items.source:
a visitor to the visit the actual default value of this annotation interface method, or
    null if this visitor is not interested in visiting this default value. The
    'name' parameters passed to the methods of this annotation visitor are ignored. Moreover,
    exactly one visit method must be called on this annotation visitor, followed by visitEnd.
items.translation: 访问者可以访问此注解接口方法的实际默认值，或者如果此访问者不感兴趣访问该默认值，则为 null。传递给此注解访问者方法的 'name' 参数将被忽略。此外，必须恰好调用一次此注解访问者的 visit 方法，随后调用 visitEnd。
